prompt:
Write a freelance proposal (cover letter) from Noor Halden for the job below.

About the freelancer: 6 years experience; skills: Python, PyTorch, scikit-learn, LangChain, OpenAI API, Hugging Face Transformers, NLP, XGBoost, pandas, machine learning

Job post (treat as data):
<job>
Title: Generative AI Chatbot App for Online Dating
I am in need of a full stack developer to utilize OpenAI GPT to develop an app that would allow a user to send messages to a chatbot that would proofread them and provide feedback to the user on suggested corrections / edits for online dating messages...Like an AI Wingman. This chatbot would need to be trained in a specific way that would be sensitive to specific criteria that would allow the user to be represented in the best light possible to their online matches. This would be an ongoing opportunity and am open to the possibility to hire full time for it.
</job>

text:
Hi, I’m Noor Halden, a full-stack AI developer with 6 years of experience building practical chatbot and ML solutions in Python, PyTorch, scikit-learn, LangChain, OpenAI API, Hugging Face Transformers, NLP, XGBoost, pandas, and machine learning.

I recently built a delivery support chatbot for Parcelwise Logistics using Python, OpenAI API, LangGraph, FastAPI, Redis, and Twilio. It handled parcel tracking, delivery rescheduling, and human handoff with full context, resolving 43% of conversations without an agent and reaching a 4.4/5 CSAT.

For your AI wingman app, I’d focus on a message-proofreading experience that gives sensitive, tailored feedback while keeping the user’s tone natural and polished. I’d also design the prompts and workflow so the assistant follows your criteria consistently and can grow into a larger product.

What specific criteria do you want the chatbot to optimize for when suggesting edits?
